description: 19 nálezů z pátého kola hloubkového auditu (commit 2176b0e, 2026-11-08). Pokrývá: model memory policy (B02), root-family admission (B01), output integrity (B10), circuit breaker (B09), recovery journal CAS (B13), PHP PSR-4 imports (B03), unified language registry (B04, B05), TS/Rust/Go import resolvers (B06, B07, B18), indexed dependencies (B08, B19), retrieval evaluation (B14), response budget (B12), vision contracts (B15, B16), warmup lifecycle (B17) a speculative inference (B11).

acceptance_criteria: Every accepted reservation has a unique reservation_id and explicit execution owner.
Coalesced scope returns the existing reservation ID but cannot release it as a different owner.
Release requires the matching reservation ID and owner; mismatched or repeated release leaves accounting unchanged.
The MCP wrapper isolates nested ContextVar state and releases only its own accepted reservation.
Focused root-family and MCP budget tests pass.
task_b01_root_family_admission.description: B01: RootFamilyBudget coalesced scope nesmí umožnit volajícímu uvolnit cizí rezervaci. Zavést reservation_id a explicitního vlastníka rezervace v mcp_server.py a budget.py.
task_b01_root_family_admission.next_action: B01 implementation and focused verification complete; remaining Round 5 tasks stay open.
task_b01_root_family_admission.title: B01 — Root-family reservation ownership: zamezení dvojímu uvolnění

acceptance_criteria: ModelExecutionPolicy._is_small_model classifies 0.5B/1B/1.5B/2B/3B as small and rejects 13B/23B/33B/130B.
At 6144 MB free VRAM, 3B keeps a 32768 context without forced unload; 13B is capped at 8192 and receives keep_alive=0s.
task_b02_model_policy.description: B02: ModelExecutionPolicy._is_small_model() používá podřetězec '3b', což chybně klasifikuje 13B/23B/33B jako malé modely. Opravit parsing velikosti modelu a VRAM admission pravidla.
task_b02_model_policy.next_action: No source change required: current parser already has the digit-aware boundary. Added regression tests in tests/unit/test_model_lifecycle_and_policy_edge_cases.py. Focused suite passed 5/5.
task_b02_model_policy.title: B02 — Model memory policy: přesná klasifikace velikosti modelu

acceptance_criteria: Composer autoload.psr-4 and autoload-dev.psr-4 mappings both resolve PHP namespace imports.
Aliased use imports with duplicate basenames resolve only to their PSR-4 mapped paths.
task_b03_php_psr4_discovery.description: B03: code_index_demand.py rozšířit PHP větev o parsování composer.json autoload.psr-4 / autoload-dev.psr-4 a regex/AST analýzu 'use Namespace\\Class;' včetně aliasů 'as ...'.
task_b03_php_psr4_discovery.next_action: Verified: B03 focused tests passed (2 passed, 7 deselected); tests/unit/test_code_index_demand.py passed 9/9 after making the EvidenceStore metadata fixture create its strict existing root and source files.
task_b03_php_psr4_discovery.title: B03 — PHP dependency resolver: podpora Composer PSR-4 use imports

acceptance_criteria: Source path tiers classify .php, .rb, .vue and .svelte as current implementation files.
Source context classification accepts explicit intent=source_analysis.
Language-independent source paths and qualified code symbols activate source-first path priority, while documentation-only paths remain documentation requests.
task_b04_b05_unified_language_registry.description: B04+B05: retrieval.py doplnit .php, .rb, .vue, .svelte do _SOURCE_SUFFIXES. Doplnit explicitní intent=source_analysis parametr a deterministické signály (přípony, cesty, symboly) pro source-first režim nezávisle na jazyku dotazu.
task_b04_b05_unified_language_registry.next_action: Focused evidence: source suffix tier tests cover .php/.rb/.vue/.svelte; explicit source_analysis intent and language-independent source path/qualified-symbol signals enable source-first priority; documentation-only query preserves input ranking. tests/unit/test_retrieval_fusion_canonical_paths.py passed 25/25.
task_b04_b05_unified_language_registry.title: B04+B05 — Unified language registry a multilingvální source-context detekce

acceptance_criteria: Relative TypeScript NodeNext imports ending in .js resolve to a unique eligible .ts implementation.
Rust nested modules resolve both parent/stem.rs and parent/stem/mod.rs layouts.
A Go import exactly matching go.mod module resolves only root package files, while subpackage imports remain scoped to their directory.
task_b06_b07_b18_import_resolvers.description: B06+B07+B18: code_index_demand.py opravit TS NodeNext .js->.ts resoluci, Rust vnořené moduly (parent/stem/mod.rs i parent/stem.rs) a Go přesnou shodu imp == module_name pro root package.
task_b06_b07_b18_import_resolvers.next_action: Focused evidence: NodeNext prefers the unique indexed .ts/.tsx counterpart over generated .js; Rust parent/stem.rs and parent/stem/mod.rs layouts resolve; exact Go module-root import returns root package file only. Combined focused suites passed 17/17.
task_b06_b07_b18_import_resolvers.title: B06+B07+B18 — Import resolvery: TypeScript NodeNext, Rust nested mod a Go root package

acceptance_criteria: Eligible paths are indexed once per one-hop/two-hop request by directory, stem, extension and basename, then reused by Go, Java, C/C++ and C# resolvers.
Go subpackage imports return files in that exact package directory; exact module-root imports return root package files.
C# using imports match declared namespaces exactly, never a filename stem alone.
task_b08_b19_indexed_dependency_lookup.description: B08+B19: code_index_demand.py předpočítat index způsobilých souborů (by_dir, by_stem, by_ext) pro eliminaci O(N*M) průchodů u Go, C#, Java a C/C++. V C# odstranit slabou shodu pouhého stemu.
task_b08_b19_indexed_dependency_lookup.next_action: Focused evidence: shared by_dir/by_stem/by_ext/by_basename index is reused across one-hop and two-hop requests; Go and Java use direct directory/stem lookups, C includes use basename lookup, C# namespace declarations are indexed once and matched exactly. RED observed four inventory iterations for four C# seeds; GREEN focused code-index/polyglot/efficiency suites passed 21/21.
task_b08_b19_indexed_dependency_lookup.title: B08+B19 — Indexed dependency lookup a přesný C# namespace matching

acceptance_criteria: allow() returns an admission carrying the generation token when it grants a half-open probe.
success()/failure() from a stale probe generation cannot mutate a newer probe or reset its open circuit.
Model-attempt completion passes its admission token into success/failure; ordinary closed-state behavior remains unchanged.
task_b09_circuit_breaker_generations.description: B09: CircuitBreakerRegistry allow() musí vracet probe generation token; success()/failure() smí měnit stav pouze pro odpovídající generaci, aby opožděný probe neresetoval novější aktivní stav.
task_b09_circuit_breaker_generations.next_action: Focused evidence: half-open allow returns the atomically captured probe generation; late success and failure from an expired generation are ignored, and the current generation closes the breaker. The model-attempt completion callsite now forwards its captured generation. RED reproduced a bool return without a generation; GREEN `tests/unit/test_resilience_circuit_breaker.py tests/test_resilience_defaults.py` passed 20/20.
task_b09_circuit_breaker_generations.title: B09 — Circuit breaker generations: ochrana před opožděnými half-open výsledky

acceptance_criteria: Every projection decision measures compact JSON encoded as UTF-8 bytes against max_output_tokens * 4.
A response that remains over budget or cannot be serialized fails closed with status=response_budget_exceeded and budget_rejected=true.

task_b12_response_size_contract.next_action: Implemented UTF-8 serialized-byte measurement and explicit rejection metadata. RED reproduced 341 bytes against a 256-byte cap; focused response-protocol suites passed 8/8.

acceptance_criteria: A supplied json_schema controls prompt instructions; the default review contract is absent and request format remains the supplied schema.
Custom-schema model output is parsed as JSON, validated against that schema, and returned as structured_output without requiring review findings fields; invalid schemas reject before runtime.
operation=fix activates repo context for a frontend bundle with root regardless of prompt language; review and describe do not activate it.
Unsupported operation values fail closed; omitted operation preserves existing keyword inference.
The local_ai_task MCP schema exposes operation as the fix|review|describe enum for vision, and forwards an explicitly supplied value.
